metadata.name: Contact Mirror
metadata.description: A second, independent PROVIDER of the showcase app's showcase/contact_lookup interface (decision 0077). Exists so a consumer that requires the interface can be shown binding to two implementers, and to one installed AFTER the consumer, with no consumer republish. Answers lookups from a small built-in fixture.

tools.name: contact_mirror_lookup_contact
tools.description: Resolve a contact id from the mirror's fixture. The contact-mirror implementation of showcase/contact_lookup op lookup_contact.

cross_tenant_tools.description: Look up one mirrored contact by id. Bound to any consumer that requires showcase/contact_lookup.
